challenges.title: URL Shortener
challenges.prompt: Design and implement the core of a URL shortener: create a short code for a long URL, redirect on lookup, and handle collisions. Discuss the encoding scheme, storage, and how you'd scale reads.
requirements: short-code generation (base62 counter or hash + collision retry)
idempotent create for the same URL (optional)
challenges.evalRubric: Code generation avoids predictable/enumerable codes if required; collision handling correct; DB schema with the right index; cache-aside for redirects; analytics write path doesn't block redirect; custom alias handling.

challenges.title: Rate Limiter
challenges.prompt: Implement a rate limiter middleware supporting N requests per window per key. Choose an algorithm (fixed window / sliding window / token bucket) and justify it. Make it work across multiple app servers.
challenges.evalRubric: Boundary burst problem addressed (why sliding window / token bucket beats fixed); atomic increment (Lua / INCR+EXPIRE race handled); memory bounded; clock skew considered; headers correct.

challenges.title: In-memory Cache with TTL + LRU
challenges.prompt: Build a cache with get/set/delete, per-entry TTL, an LRU eviction policy with a max size, and O(1) operations. Discuss thread-safety and stampede protection.
requirements: O(1) get/set via hashmap + doubly linked list
challenges.evalRubric: DLL pointer updates correct on access and eviction; expired entries not served; single-flight prevents thundering herd; TTL jitter; no unbounded growth from tombstones.

challenges.title: Background Job Queue
challenges.prompt: Design a job queue: enqueue, worker pull, at-least-once delivery, retries with exponential backoff, a dead-letter queue, and visibility timeout so a crashed worker's job is retried.
challenges.evalRubric: Claim is atomic; visibility timeout re-queues abandoned jobs; backoff formula correct with jitter; DLQ path; idempotency keys recommended for consumers; poison-message isolation.

challenges.title: Cursor Pagination API
challenges.prompt: Implement keyset (cursor) pagination for a feed sorted by created_at. Explain why offset pagination breaks at scale and how you handle ties and deletions.
challenges.evalRubric: Composite key (sort col + unique id) prevents skips/dupes; cursor is opaque + tamper-resistant; index supports the WHERE clause; bidirectional or forward-only stated; limit+1 trick for has_more.

challenges.title: Idempotent POST endpoint
challenges.prompt: Make a payment-creation POST endpoint safe to retry: an Idempotency-Key header returns the original result on replay, even under concurrent duplicate requests.
requirements: Idempotency-Key stored with request fingerprint + response
concurrent duplicates: one wins, others wait or 409
challenges.evalRubric: Unique constraint / SELECT FOR UPDATE / INSERT ... ON CONFLICT to serialize; in-progress state so a second request doesn't double-charge; response replayed verbatim with original status; request hash comparison.

challenges.title: Reliable Webhook Delivery
challenges.prompt: Design outbound webhook delivery: signed payloads, retries with backoff, ordering guarantees (or lack thereof), consumer-side replay protection, and a way for customers to see failed deliveries.
challenges.evalRubric: Signature scheme prevents forgery + replay; retries async off the request path; per-endpoint isolation so one bad consumer doesn't block others; event IDs for consumer dedupe; backpressure.

challenges.title: Feature Flag Service
challenges.prompt: Build the read path for a feature flag service: evaluate a flag for a user with percentage rollouts and targeting rules, with sub-millisecond evaluation and safe fallbacks.
challenges.evalRubric: Same user stays in the same bucket as % grows (monotonic); rule evaluation order defined; SDK caches ruleset, not per-eval network calls; default value on any error; kill switch.

challenges.title: In-memory Full-text Search
challenges.prompt: Build a tiny search engine: index documents, support AND/OR/phrase queries, rank by TF-IDF or BM25, and update the index on document change.
requirements: tokenization + stop words + stemming (or justify skipping)
challenges.evalRubric: Postings sorted for merge-intersection; phrase queries use positional data; scoring formula correct; deletes handled (tombstones or rebuild); memory bounded.

challenges.title: Database Connection Pool
challenges.prompt: Implement a connection pool: min/max size, acquire with timeout, health-check on checkout, idle reaping, and graceful drain on shutdown.
challenges.evalRubric: No connection leak on error paths (finally/using); waiter queue is FIFO and cancellable; broken connections not returned to pool; reaper doesn't kill in-use; shutdown deterministic.

challenges.title: Leader Election / Distributed Lock
challenges.prompt: Implement a leader-election primitive over a store with TTL (Redis/etcd-style): one node holds a lease, renews it, and others take over on failure — without two leaders.
requirements: acquire lease with TTL + unique token
fencing token to prevent stale-leader writes
challenges.evalRubric: Compare-and-set on the token (no blind DEL); renewal margin accounts for RTT; fencing token passed to protected resource; split-brain window discussed; jittered retry.

challenges.title: High-throughput Metrics Counter
challenges.prompt: Build a counter service that ingests millions of increments/sec and serves approximate per-minute rates with low read latency.
requirements: read: current rate + last N minutes
lossy under overload is OK — say so
challenges.evalRubric: Write path lock-free or striped; bucket rotation correct at minute boundaries; reads aggregate across shards; memory is O(windows), not O(events); backpressure/sampling strategy.
